focused_gui.scope: Classic v11 light at scale 1 and dark at scale 2 with repeated layout. Each of seven group captions is painted exactly once at 14 points with a legible theme shade. Select/Brush retain accessible names and selected state, have 64x60 buttons with centered 32-point image shapes, and do not repeat text inside the button. Both tools activate without document/history changes.

gpu_scenes.scope: Actual wgpu-backed egui theme scene exports for Classic workspace/text/settings and Studio workspace/settings. Archived raw 1100x900 light/dark Classic scenes show the revised captions and icon-only controls. Rendered inspection caught initial left alignment; final centered images are checked by the focused regression.
gpu_scenes.before_image_source: Previous canvas-fade record, source commit 473269d; images copied unchanged.

regression_baseline.result: Before the change, the caption-size regression fails on Selection: 12 points rather than 14.
regression_baseline.probe_scope: The initial caption assertion, before later primary-tool checks. The image-centering assertion was strengthened after rendered review.

scope: Classic v11 alone uses larger, higher-contrast 14-point group captions and icon-only Select/Brush controls. The shared tool widgets, Studio and historical skins retain their own presentation. Tool actions still use the shared host path; names stay available to accessibility and one hover tooltip.
limits: This qualifies the caption/icon layout slice through headless paint geometry and rendered scene inspection, not full Windows parity or native menu/desktop appearance. Other icon styling, menus/dialog comparisons and remaining editing/platform features stay open.
